verdict.rationale: Galileo's Experiments evaluate prompts, models, and app code against well-defined inputs and curated datasets, which can be built from synthetic or development data. Experiments can also be created from the UI or via MCP from an IDE, which gives an offline testing path separate from live production logging. However, nothing in the evidence describes a dedicated sandbox or staging environment, or any guarantee that tests are isolated from production data. Missing for 10: explicit sandbox/test environment or project isolation, documented separation of test vs production data, independent or hands-on corroboration.
